desc: An ingredient used in crafting recipes.
obtain: is harvested from Kindlewastes Flowers, found in the Kindlewastes biome. Kindlewastes flowers can also be grown from Kindlewastes Flower Seedlings.

desc: A rare gem famous for its magical properties as a catalyst. It's great for channeling and shielding!
obtain: Mined from blue veins along the cliffs of the Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes. thumb|alt=Lapislazuli can be found in the Kindlewastes, especially in areas toward the northern border of the biome.|Lapislazuli can be found in the Kindlewastes, especially in areas toward the northern border of the biome.

desc: A versatile and durable material, that is smooth to the touch. It has also the advantage of being waterproof.
ingredients_zh: 干燥毛皮 x10、盐 x20、氨腺 x2

desc: Legendary runes are imbued with an immense amount of magical energy. These rare and powerful artifacts are used to ```enhance``` legendary weapons, unlocking their full potential.
ingredients_zh: 符文 x25
obtain: Can be obtained by defeating powerful enemies, can also be crafted at the Blacksmith

desc: The best stories start small, for example with this stone.
obtain: Mined from cliffs and rock formations throughout the Nomad Highlands.

desc: The natural fiber won from the processing of Flax.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻 x2
obtain: is crafted at either the Hand Spindle, the Spinning Wheel, or the Spinning Machine. The Hand Spindle produces 6 Linen per minute, making it the fastest but most Flax-intensive. The Spinning Wheel is the slowest at 2 Linen per minute, but uses half as much Flax per Linen as the Hand Spindle. The Spinning Machine balances speed and efficiency, averaging 3.75 Linen per minute and using 50% less Flax per Linen than the Spinning Wheel, though it produces in batches.

desc: It glows in the dark. A moody light source often found in or around caves.
A malleable material that is especially useful for construction purposes.
obtain:
Lumps of Clay can be mined from clay deposits, commonly found in the Revelwood. Clay deposits look like large clumps of orange-brown mud. thumb|left|alt=An ingame screenshot showing a mineable clay deposit. It is reddish-brown and lumpy.|A mineable clay deposit.
fr:Tas d'argile

desc: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all the pieces?
obtain: Mae's Map Piece is found at Skeleton Excavation Camp "Mae".

desc: Useful for flesh wounds.
ingredients_zh: 焦油 x5、雾霭蒸汽 x1、硝石 x1、硫磺 x1

desc: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.
obtain: are common drops from Scavengers. It can also be looted from destroyed metal objects or picked up as a physical item in the world. The Scavengers around Rookmore are a good source in the early game. fr:Ferraille

desc: Sheets melted out of Metal Scraps to make them more workable and open up options for further processing.
ingredients_zh: 木炭 x2、金属碎料 x2
obtain: Metal Sheets can be crafted at the Forge, which can be created at the Blacksmith.

desc: A dense, swirling vapor extracted from Fell Sicklescythe. It is imbued with ethereal Shroud magic, making it invaluable for crafting magical armor and powering devastating spells.
obtain: Dropped by Fell Sicklescythe, first found in the Kindlewastes. The quest will take you to a Haunted Sun Temple, where one can be found.

desc: Large ribs of the most vile Fell Monster.
obtain: Dropped by Fell Monstrosity, first found in the Nomad Highlands biome.

desc: A lovely patch of green moss. It can be used for highly effective bandages.
An inconspicuous moth ripped from its natural ecosystem to be used as an alchemic ingredient. Can only be found at night in the fields of the Revelwood.
obtain: Can be found in the Revelwood at night.

desc: The natural iridescent material that pearls are made of, it can be found lining the inside of certain shells and valued for its luminous shimmer.
ingredients_zh: 珍珠 x1

desc: Mycelium of mushrooms that have been absorbing the magical properties of the Shroud. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?
obtain: In the Shroud, mine ground to gain Mycelium. fr:Mycélium (Matériaux)

desc: Nails made from Metal Scraps. Sharp objects that can be used as a tool or to improve a weapon.
ingredients_zh: 金属碎料 x1
obtain: Nails can be obtained by collecting loot or by crafting at the Blacksmith.

desc: A dangerous alchemical substance used to produce explosives. Better watch out!
ingredients_zh: 沙子 x5、雾霭沙 x5、木酸液 x1、盐 x1
obtain: Nitrate is created in a Laboratory.

desc: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
obtain: Nomad Highlands Dirt can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

desc: Finely ground obsidian powder. It can more easily be alchemized in this form.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x1

desc: A stack of old parchments, worn and torn by the ravages of time. A wise man could salvage something from the remnants
The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all the pieces?
obtain: Ony's Map Piece is found at Skeleton Excavation Camp "Ony". The piece is located in a nest on top of the large skeleton.

desc: Orange dyed fabric used for clothing.
ingredients_zh: 布料 x1、萱草 x1

desc: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all the pieces?
obtain: Orpheus' Map Piece is found at Giant Skeleton "Orpheus". THe piece is located in a chest on the ground by the head of the skeleton.

desc: A basic ingredient for all advanced armor. The padding added below the hard shell can create comfort and soften impacts. A Loom is needed to craft both padding and advanced armor.
ingredients_zh: 布料 x3、皮革 x1、树脂 x2、亚麻布 x2

desc: Vibrant palm leaves that offer ample shade in the blazing sun. They can be used as a crafting ingredient.
obtain: is obtained from chopping down palm trees in Veilwater Basin. Can be obtained from fully grown Licuala Seedling.

desc: Logs of a freshly cut palm, ready to be processed into an item of choosing.
obtain: Palm Wood Logs are obtained from chopping down palm trees in the Kindlewastes biome.

desc: A traditional but mighty tool of communication. Used for the preservation of knowledge.
ingredients_zh: 原木 x1、氨腺 x1

desc: These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.
obtain: is gathered from reeds near water, or in bamboo forests. thumb|right|Reeds near water can be harvested for Paper Reeds. thumb|right|Reeds in Bamboo Forests can be harvested for Paper Reeds.

desc: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.
obtain: Passionflower are harvested from plants in the Veilwater Basin at night. The plant grows pink and is easily seen from afar.

desc: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.
obtain: Draks have a low chance to drop. Otherwise they can be found underwater in clams.

desc: A dense, stone-like carapace torn from the Stalker, a ruthless assassin of the Shroud. Its near-unbreakable structure makes it a crucial material for forging tough and resilient armor.
obtain: Dropped by the Shroud Stalker, first found in the Nomad Highlands.

desc: A little pillbug, also called a roly-poly. It can be found in the Albaneve Summits and used as fishing bait, especially popular among rare fish.
obtain: Can be found in the Albaneve Summits. Can be found at night.

desc: A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications
obtain: Pink Mushroom Meats are obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Veilwater Basin Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms. Large stalks may drop as many as x8-12 Pink Mushroom Meats.

desc: Piscine Ivory, often called the ivory of the sea, ground into a bright powder. Renowned for its strength and resilience, it can even serve as a component in metal alloys, lending them exceptional robustness.
ingredients_zh: 鱼牙 x1

desc: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.
obtain: is gathered from bushes found throughout Embervale. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world. Bushes can also be grown from Shrub Seedlings. fr:Fibre de plante

desc: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all the pieces?
obtain: Polaris' Map Piece is found at Giant Skeleton "Polaris". The piece is located in a chest, in the mouth of the skeleton.

desc: A green glowing material that's been cleansed to rid it of its toxic characteristics.
ingredients_zh: 木炭 x3、盐 x10、毒液黏浆 x3、木酸液 x1
obtain: Purified Slime is created in the Ectoplasm Press.

desc: Bait that increases the chance of catching rare fish.
ingredients_zh: 圣甲虫 x1、金币 x15、水豚鬃毛 x2、鱼牙 x1、球虫 x1

ingredients_zh: 玉米芯 x1、生瘦肉 x1

desc: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked.
obtain: Can be harvested from Rice Seedling

obtain: Raw Wool can be obtained sometimes by killing Yaks or taming them, when provided shelter, a bed and food they will provide Raw Wool for you.

desc: Red - the color of the Flame fitting for a Flameborn!
ingredients_zh: 布料 x1、硫磺 x1

desc: The simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.
obtain: Can be found in the Hollow Halls

obtain: Crafted at the Hunter.

obtain: is dropped from Snapjaws.

desc: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.
ingredients_zh: 爬行动物皮 x1、盐 x3

desc: This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
obtain: Resin can be obtained through chopping down trees. It can be more quickly obtained by chopping trees with red leaves and grown Revelwood Red Leaf Seedlings. fr:Résine

desc: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
obtain: Revelwoods Dirt can be found in the Revelwood.

desc: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.

desc: An interesting plant, stimulating every persons taste buds. The use in tea has established itself as a custom.
obtain: is obtained from Rooibos bushes, found in the Nomad Highlands biome. Rooibos bushes can also be grown from Rooibos Seedlings.

desc: Runes attract and store magical energy from all around them. Used to enhance weapons.
obtain: Runes can be obtained from defeating Fell enemies, looting chests, or dismantling weapons.

desc: A rare herbal plant that can be found in hot areas of the world.
obtain: is obtained from Saffron plants, found in the Kindlewastes biome. Large amounts can be found at Sunsimmer Souterrain and Rose Shell Burrow. Saffron plants can also be grown from Saffron Seedlings.

desc: Crystalline powder which can be found in enshrouded valleys. The taste of food can be improved drastically when sprinkled with salt.
obtain: is mined from salt deposits in the Springlands, such as Egerton Salt Mines or Saline Quarry. The objective of the first quest given by the Hunter - - shows you the location of a large salt deposit at Egerton Salt Mines and requires you to collect salt there. fr:Sel

desc: Sand, glittering like gold on a hot summers day, is shifty even in the best of hours.
obtain: Mined from the the ground in the Kindlewastes.

desc: Hardened scales of wild animals. Some say they are as hard as stone.
obtain: Scales are dropped by Dune Armadillos and Scorpions in the Kindlewastes. They are also collected from domesticated Dune Armadillos.

desc: A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.
obtain: Can be found in the Kindlewastes, mostly night (includes dusk), on rocky patches of grass and rocky flat areas.

desc: She is less fearsome when headless. The acidic scent lingers, however.
The shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.
obtain: Can be found at night in the Kindlewastes biome.

desc: A type of limestone derived from seashells
obtain: can be found in Veilwater Basin. FR:Calcaire de coquille

desc: A thick, viscius substance harvested from Shroud Flayers. Its tenacious bonding properties make it essential for crafting armor and securely sticking materials together in various crafting recipes.
obtain: Dropped by Shroud Flayers, first found in the Nomad Highlands. Can be obtained from Shroud Flayer Seedling.

desc: A stable form of energy. Burning it at the Flame Altar may protect against the Shroud.

obtain: Dropped by Fell bosses, commonly found guarding Shroud Roots and Elixir Wells. Can also be crafted by the Alchemist.

desc: A translucent, gelatinous substance extracted from Shroud Depthdwellers. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties. Essential for crafting healing spells and magical wards.
obtain: Can be obtained from Shroud Depthdwellers.

desc: Shroud infused soil seems dangerous at first glance. However, when used in a controlled environment, it can create a potent bioactive environment that encourages rapid growth.
ingredients_zh: 甲壳粉 x5、雾霭沙 x10
obtain: Crafted at the Farmer.

obtain: thumb Shroud Liquid can be found in the Shroud, looted from mushrooms on the ground and gathered using tools from larger mushrooms.

desc: A mushroom that is commonly found in the Shroud of the Revelwood biome. It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
obtain: Shroud Mushrooms are obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Revelwood Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms. Large stalks may drop as many as x8-12 Shroud Mushrooms.

desc: Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.
ingredients_zh: 雾瘴粒子 x10、迷雾粘合剂 x5、薄荷蘑菇肉 x10
obtain: Crafted at the Alchemist. They also drop from the Fell Monstrosity and the Fell Sicklescythe.

desc: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores.
obtain: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Nomad Highlands biome.

desc: The Highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus
ingredients_zh: 雾霭遗物 x10、绿矾粉尘 x5、粉色蘑菇肉 x10
obtain: Crafted at the Alchemist.

desc: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to Shroud Particles.
obtain: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Veilwater Basin biome.

desc: An organic bag containing highly concentrated Shroud spores.
Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores.
ingredients_zh: 砂岩 x10、酸性菌丝 x5
obtain: Mined from glowing yellow patches of sand in the Kindlewastes Shroud.

desc: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.
Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge. All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied visconsity.
ingredients_zh: 雾霭黏液 x5、雾瘴凝胶 x5、粉色蘑菇肉 x5

desc: Shroud Spores are particles of energy that create and give the shroud its corrupting power.
obtain: Shroud Spores are found by looting weaker Shroud creatures.

desc: A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.
ingredients_zh: 雾锁之冰 x10、活性菌丝 x15、盐 x20

desc: The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.
obtain: Shroud Wood can be gathered in the Shroud by chopping down trees found there.

desc: Citizens of Embervale would sometimes invest in silver in the hope it would hold its value during a crisis. A crisis did come, but the silver offered little help.

desc: Fine, shimmery silver powder. Don't drop it, or you'll find specs of silver in your floorboards for weeks to come.
ingredients_zh: 银锭 x1

desc: Silver is a precious metal often found in combination with other minerals. This raw silver ore will need to be processed to become useful.
Very simple fishing bait made out of Critter Parts. Can be used to catch common fish, but not many will like the taste of that one.
ingredients_zh: 小动物部件 x1、任意植物 x4

desc: Powdery, lily-white snow. The way it drowns out the sounds of chaos makes he world seem just a little more peaceful.
A small amount of essence from the Flame! By feeding it back to the Flame Altar maybe it could become stronger and burn even brighter.
obtain: Sparks can be collected from Flame Shrines and Flame Sanctums found throughout Embervale. The amount of sparks gathered is decided by the biome the Flame Shrine and Sanctum reside. : Springlands x1 : Revelwood x2 : Nomad Highlands x3 : Kindlewastes x4 : Albaneve Summits x5 : Veilwater Basin x6

desc: Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!
ingredients_zh: 藏红花 x1、雾霭沙 x15、洋甘菊 x1、路易波士茶 x1、燃烬荒原之花 x2

desc: A gland that's seemingly dripping with poison. Don't think about it too much, or the visual will haunt your dreams. Found on poison-spitting spiders and can be used in crafting to produce an antidote to Hemotoxin.
obtain: Can be looted from Spiders.

desc: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
obtain: Springlands Dirt can be found in the Springlands.

desc: A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death. Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.
obtain: Found at night in the Albaneve Summits biome.

desc: As an alloy of both iron and carbon, steel possesses better resistance and therefore provides more protection when used in armor.
ingredients_zh: 铁矿石 x20、煤炭 x40

desc: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.

desc: A natural plant, remains of the agriculture left behind, that grows in the world. It offers protection from the elements when used as building material.
obtain: is obtained from wheat plants, found at the Bounty Barn or Rattlebleak in the Nomad Highlands biome. Each plant yields Wheat Grains and x2 Straw. Wheat plants can also be grown from Wheat Seedlings.

desc: Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.

obtain: is crafted by Manual Crafting, by the Spinning Wheel, or by the Spinning Machine. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock. is also a common drop from Spiders. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.

desc: A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads:
ingredients_zh: 梅的地图碎片 x1、波拉里斯的地图碎片 x1、俄耳甫斯的地图碎片 x1、奥妮的地图碎片 x1
obtain: The Dragons' Map can be crafted with Manual Crafting.

obtain: Mined from Tin veins in mines and cave passages in the Nomad Highlands Shroud. The Wiki's Map shows what veins each Mine and Cave Passage have, if any, when its icon is clicked on.

desc: Torn and tattered remains of cloth that were left behind and now serve the Scavengers as clothing
obtain: fr:Tissu déchiré

desc: A large gland filled with lethal substance. Handle it with care.
Mined from the deadly waste found in the Hollow Halls. Caution is advised!
obtain: Toxic Slime can be obtained by mining the green deadly waste inside of Hollow Halls.

desc: This tropical wood can be harvested from ancient trees. It is very sturdy!
obtain: Tropical Wood is obtained from chopping down large trees in the Veilwater Basin biome. fr:Bois tropical

desc: A twig, as insignificant as it might seem, has a lot of potential. Everything starts somewhere...
ingredients_zh: 任意木材 x1

desc: Bait that increases the chance of catching uncommon fish.
ingredients_zh: 飞蛾 x1、金币 x12、水豚鬃毛 x2、鱼骨 x1、蚱蜢 x1

desc: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.

desc: A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.

desc: A sharp, organic stinger. Don't get pricked, or you'll have venom rushing through your veins!
obtain: Dropped by Pink Giant Wasp in Veilwater Basin

desc: A luscious, dyed fabric, usually reserved for creating the finest garments.
ingredients_zh: 布料 x1、苯胺紫染料 x1

desc: The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!
obtain: Vukah Brawler Head is a drop from Vukah Brawlers, encountered starting in the Springlands.

desc: A warmer and better-insulated padding kit. When used to create armor, it will protect you from the bitter cold.
ingredients_zh: 布料 x3、皮革 x1、树脂 x2、羊毛 x4

desc: This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from reptiles that prefer wet or water-filled environments.
obtain: is dropped from Water Reptiles in Veilwater Basin.

desc: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.
ingredients_zh: 水爬虫皮 x1、盐 x3

desc: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.
obtain: Can be obtained while fishing when you fail to reel in a fish.

desc: Both a cooking ingredient and a seed for the fields.

ingredients_zh: 任意木材 x15、任意泥土 x3
obtain: You'll unlock the Wood Acid recipe once you craft Charcoal for the first time. Crafted in a Charcoal Kiln, this recipe produce 10 Wood Acids in 7 minutes.

desc: Planks created by cutting Wood Logs into shape. Very useful for building.
ingredients_zh: 任意木材 x1

desc: Refined wool. It can be used for weaving garments and warm padding.
ingredients_zh: 生羊毛 x20

desc: Useful for flesh wounds.
ingredients_zh: 抗菌剂 x1、洋甘菊 x2、龙胆 x2、银尘 x1

desc: Yellow dyed fabric used for clothing.
ingredients_zh: 布料 x1、藏红花 x1
